title: Roustabouts, Oil and Gas
description: Assemble or repair oil field equipment using hand and power tools. Perform other tasks as needed.

tasks.text: Unscrew or tighten pipes, casing, tubing, and pump rods, using hand and power wrenches and tongs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on plumbing in structures

tasks.text: Dismantle and repair oil field machinery, boilers, and steam engine parts, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of mechanical equipment

tasks.text: Guide cranes to move loads about decks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Walk flow lines to locate leaks, using electronic detectors and by making visual inspections, and repair the leaks.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical locating of worn parts needs hands-on presence

dwas.name: Locate equipment or materials in need of repair or replacement.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Production equipment installation is physical trade work

tasks.text: Bolt together pump and engine parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assembly of products by hand

tasks.text: Move pipes to and from trucks, using truck winches and motorized lifts, or by hand.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical loading in construction or extraction

dwas.name: Load or unload materials used in construction or extraction.

tasks.text: Clean trucks used in the fields.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on washing of vehicle surfaces and parts

tasks.text: Dig holes, set forms, and mix and pour concrete into forms to make foundations for wood or steel derricks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.
Pour materials into or on designated areas.

tasks.text: Supply equipment to rig floors as requested and provide assistance to roughnecks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of construction materials on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.
Move construction or extraction materials to locations where they are needed.

tasks.text: Clean up spilled oil by bailing it into barrels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Work site cleaning is physical labor

tasks.text: Dig drainage ditches around wells and storage tanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual digging with tools in ground

tasks.text: Cut down and remove trees and brush to clear drill sites, to reduce fire hazards, and to make way for roads to sites.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual clearing of debris and vegetation outdoors

dwas.name: Remove debris or vegetation from work sites.
